description: SEALED VALIDATION SET — written 2026-09-08 BEFORE any candidate model was downloaded, converted or scored. Mirrors holdout.json's shape so the two are directly comparable.
_seal: This file is opened ONCE, to validate a candidate already chosen on holdout.json. It is never used for selection, never tuned toward, and never consulted while a candidate is being fitted or a threshold set. Scoring it during selection burns it, and a burnt validation set cannot be un-burnt - write a replacement and record that this one was spent.
_why_it_exists: holdout.json became selection data the moment a candidate is chosen by its holdout score. That is the same trap as authoring markers against the signed corpus (measured 2026-09-08: 24/24 signed, 0/13 holdout), one level up. This set is the check that the winner generalises rather than happening to suit holdout.json.
_authored_blind: No candidate model had been run, and no candidate result seen, at the time these cases were written. The families mirror holdout.json deliberately so a regression in a family the current model handles well is visible, not just an improvement in the family we are hunting.
